episode_id: Some setting in my config has been renamed upstream. Sort the config out. Rename the old key in my own override file, and keep that file out of git./seed-12-config_renamed-29980

reason: negative side failed: preconditions accepted 1 of 2 same-intent states (config_renamed seed 2 resolves to 'migrate_local', which accepts ['migrate_local']), and that is the state the program was compiled from: it declares variant 'rename', but the solution it was compiled from is a 'migrate_local' resolution there, so the declared variant, not the preconditions, is what is wrong

refused_program.body:
set -euo pipefail

map=
while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
  case "$f" in
    *[Rr][Ee][Nn][Aa][Mm][Ee]*)
      if grep -Eq '^[[:space:]]*[^#[:space:]=]+[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*[^#[:space:]=]+' "$f"; then
        map=$f
        break
      fi
      ;;
  esac
done < <(git ls-files -z)
[ -n "$map" ] || { echo "no tracked rename map found" >&2; exit 1; }

pairs=$(awk '
  {
    line=$0
    sub(/[[:space:]]*#.*$/, "", line)
    if (line ~ /^[[:space:]]*$/) next
    eq=index(line, "=")
    if (eq == 0) next
    old=substr(line,1,eq-1)
    new=substr(line,eq+1)
    gsub(/^[[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+$/, "", old)
    gsub(/^[[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+$/, "", new)
    if (old != "" && new != "") print old "=" new
  }' "$map")
[ -n "$pairs" ] || { echo "rename map is empty" >&2; exit 1; }

while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
  if ! grep -Iq . "$file"; then
    continue
  fi

  tmp=$(mktemp "${file}.XXXXXX")
  awk -v pairs="$pairs" '
    BEGIN {
      n = split(pairs, lines, "\n")
      for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        eq = index(lines[i], "=")
        if (eq > 0) {
          old = substr(lines[i], 1, eq-1)
          new = substr(lines[i], eq+1)
          repl[old] = new
        }
      }
    }
    {
      eq = index($0, "=")
      if (eq == 0) { print; next }
      left = substr($0, 1, eq-1)
      right = substr($0, eq+1)
      key = left
      gsub(/^[[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+$/, "", key)
      if (key in repl) {
        pos = index(left, key)
        if (pos > 0) {
          left = substr(left, 1, pos-1) repl[key] substr(left, pos+length(key))
        }
      }
      print left "=" right
    }
  ' "$file" > "$tmp"

  if ! cmp -s "$file" "$tmp"; then
    cat "$tmp" > "$file"
  fi
  rm -f "$tmp"
done < <(git ls-files --others --ignored --exclude-standard -z)
